_comment: Payment links live here. Set STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK for photo editing and STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK_ENHANCE for photo enhancement to the full Stripe Payment Link URL (https://buy.stripe.com/...). Leave a key as an empty string until that link exists. Rebuild with python3 scripts/build.py after changing this file. Forms post to /api/submit (Vercel function, emails via Resend to FORM_TO_EMAIL set in Vercel env); ORDER_FORM_ENDPOINT is unused. CONTACT_EMAIL is shown publicly if set; leave empty until a real mailbox exists on the domain. Do not put secret keys here. A Payment Link URL is public.
